name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
title: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd - 544469 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q4 pre-sales INR462 cr (+177% YoY) and FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR1,800–2,000 cr, but collections (INR82 cr vs INR308 cr revenue) lag and all four new launches are still in basement.

triggers.label: Collections INR82 cr vs revenue INR308 cr
triggers.quote: Collection for the quarter stood at INR82 crores.

triggers.label: FY27 pre-sales INR1,800–2,000 cr
triggers.quote: we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre -sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores

triggers.label: Pricing 10–25% above competitors
triggers.quote: our pricing in any micro market we are about 10 to 20, 25% higher than any other competitor

guidance.quote: we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre -sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores
along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%
along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%

guidance.metric: Input and labour cost impact on project cost
guidance.quote: On an annualized basis, this may translate into a approximate 1% increase in overall project cost.

red_flags.label: Collections far below revenue recognition
red_flags.quote: Collection for the quarter stood at INR82 crores.

red_flags.label: Projects delayed multiple quarters, approvals pending
red_flags.quote: all these projects are now getting delayed like more than like three, four quarters

red_flags.label: RERA carpet area inconsistency between presentations
red_flags.quote: the RERA carpet area was 177,000 and now it has reduced to 17,830 square foot

evasions.quote: But as soon as all the project on the plinth, then there would be a continuous flow.
So two projects we have to get multiple approvals. One is one is existing hospital.
